# Description

Summarize the change, its motivation, and the issue it addresses.

Fixes #

## Scope

- [ ] Bug fix for the WotLK backport
- [ ] WotLK 3.3.5a compatibility change
- [ ] Port of existing upstream behavior
- [ ] Repository or documentation maintenance

## Testing

Describe local checks and in-client testing.

- [ ] Modified Lua files parse with Lua 5.1
- [ ] `luacheck . -q` passes
- [ ] TOC/XML load order and file references were verified
- [ ] Tested in a WotLK 3.3.5a client where applicable
- [ ] Compared with the relevant upstream implementation

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves upstream structure where practical
- [ ] Original attribution and author metadata remain intact
- [ ] No bundled library or generated data was changed unnecessarily
- [ ] Documentation or changelog entries were updated when required
